field_docs.infection: delay_seconds: seconds from infection until the unit turns into a zombie; bite_chance: chance 0..1 that one zombie bite infects (1.0 = every bite)
field_docs.countdown: The number floating over an infected unit. color_start / color_urgent: RGB 0..1 at full / zero time left; height: metres above the unit's feet; font_size: whole number >= 1
field_docs.treatment: medic_class: class id (soldier_classes.json) that can treat without an antidote; medic_treat_time: seconds a treatment takes (the patient's countdown pauses meanwhile and resumes if it is interrupted); medic_cooldown: seconds before the same medic can treat again; medic_range: metres to the patient (must be kept while treating); antidote_range: metres within which an antidote can be used. Antidote uses per item are 'antidote_uses' in gear.json
field_docs.debug: start_infected_count: units infected when the mission starts (civilians first, then soldiers at deploy; civilians are defined in mission.json); the --start-infected=N launch argument overrides it
